The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerkâ€™s office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on the agenda or other matters within the Planning Commissionâ€™s purview except with regard to items listed as public hearings.
To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speakerâ€™s card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak. Be advised that the Chair may limit speaking time at his discretion.
During a Public Hearing:
Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing item. Please provide a speakerâ€™s card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Chair. Your speaking time will be limited to the subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Chair may limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of TEN (10) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Commission.
NOTICE
If you challenge any action of the Planning Commission in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the City Clerk at, or prior to, the public hearing (Gov. Code 65009(b)(2).)

  City of La Habra Heights
  Regular Meeting of the La Habra Heights Planning Commission
  March 24, 2015

Opening Ceremonies

Regular Business

1.  CallMeeting to Order — At 6: 00 p. m. Chairman Black called the Regular
Planning Commission Meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Chairman  Larry Black, Commissioners Ray Fernandez, Ross Owen, Greg
Stefflre and Alex Villanueva

Also Present: Jim  Priest,  Deputy City Attorney; Ben Kim, Principal Planner; and
Sandra Studer, Deputy City Clerk/Records Manager
Absent: None

3.  Flag Salute

4.  Public Comment

Consent Calendar

5.  Minutes of November 25, 2014— Regular Meeting

Action: Moved ( Steffire),  seconded ( Fernandez),  and voted 4-0 with one abstention
Villanueva) to approve the Minutes of the November 25, 2014 Regular Meeting.

6.  Monthly Community Development Department Report

Action: Moved ( Steffire), seconded ( Villanueva), and voted 5- 0 to receive and file the
Monthly Community Development Department Report.

  Public Hearing

 7.  Standards Modification Request for 368 East Road (George Liang,
  Applicant) to Utilize Provisions of LHHMC Chapter 7. 17 and 7. 18 for the
  Construction of a New 2,809 sq. ft. Single Family Home

 Action: Moved ( Fernandez), seconded ( Owen), and voted 5- 0 to adopt Resolution  No.
 2015- 01 A Resolution of the Planning Commission of the City of La Habra Heights
 Approving Standards Modification ( PRJ 2013- 111) for the construction of a New Single
 Family Home at 368 East Road.

 Administrative Items

 8.  Discussion of Story Pole Policy

 By Commissioner Consensus:  Agendize an item that provides alternatives for
 moving forward an amendment to the City's current story pole policy that includes
 research from at least three other cities as to the criteria they are using for
 implementation of the use of story poles.

 Requested by Chairman Black - Agendize an item for discussion of placing a site plan
 on the board at project sites.

 Staff Comments

 None

 Planning Commission Comments

 By Commissioner Consensus: Agendize a discussion regarding the application
 process for planning projects that includes an overview of the process an application
 goes through, such as what happens to documents for a project that is withdrawn or is
 never completed and what documents are available on the City's website.
